about: The corpse run (Dom 2026-10-28, Valheim style; 'no switches, just get everything live in game': on by default, no URL flag of its own, it rides the progression save so ?save=off and ?pitborn=v1 leave the game as it was). Built on the hero death and respawn loop (data/hero-death.json) and the save (data/progression.json, src/progression.ts). `coins`: V3 had no currency, so each boss kill pays `perKill` coins (a boss id in `perBoss` pays its own number) into the hero's CARRIED coins. Carried coins are unbanked: they bank (`banked`, safe from death) when the hero stands within `bank.radiusMetres` of the camp, the pit's mark where he respawns. `cap`: the most any one counter holds. When the hero dies, his carried coins and the weapon he carries (only an unlocked one; the fight row's own weapon is never dropped) leave him as a pile where he fell and he respawns at camp with no coins and the weapon withdrawn from his save (the next load draws the starter until he retrieves it; the weapon already drawn on his rig stays for the rest of that visit, as the scene builds the rig once). ONE pile: dying again before retrieval loses the older pile (its coins are gone; its weapon is withheld until that boss falls again, `lost` in the save). Walking within `pile.reachMetres` of the pile gives everything back and a plain HUD line says so (no pop-up). `linger`: the boss that killed him stands at the pile (its spot moves there, so the existing aggro, leash and walk-home rules apply unchanged) with `leashRadius` metres of leash for `seconds`, then goes home; there is no new AI. The pile is drawn from existing parts only: a DOM ring and beam (`marker`) at the pile's screen spot, and a gold blip on the radar (data/radar.json classes.pile). The pile lives in the save beside the kills (position, contents, the killer); `version` is the pile record's own version, so a pile written by another version is ignored, never repaired. Ranges: limits.

pile.lostLine: The {weapon} is lost until its boss falls again
